title: General.
officialText:
Clothes dryers shall be tested in accordance with ANSI Z21.5.1 or ANSI Z21.5.2 and shall be installed in accordance
with the manufacturer’s installation instructions.
SECTION FGC 614
CLOTHES DRYER EXHAUST
